note: Wyoming reports abuse to the county field office where it happened rather than to a statewide hotline, with 911 as the around-the-clock route. It also has a Department of Family Services ombudsman who takes complaints about the Department's own handling of a case, which is the escalation route when a report goes nowhere.

channels.name: Wyoming Mental Health Professions Licensing Board
channels.what_it_can_do: Licenses and disciplines Wyoming's counselors, certified alcohol and drug abuse counselors and certified mental health workers. Anyone may complain - clients and former clients, family members, colleagues and co-workers all do.
channels.what_it_cannot_do: Complaints can only be filed against individuals, not against a practice or a program.
channels.who_to_report: A licensed or certified mental health professional in Wyoming.
channels.how: File through the Board's complaints page. A copy of your complaint goes to the licence or certificate holder.
channels.note: The Board says the review, investigation and legal stages may take a long time, depending on the complexity of the case and the caseload already waiting.

channels.name: Wyoming Board of Psychology
channels.what_it_can_do: Licenses and disciplines psychologists in Wyoming.
channels.how: File through the Board's public page.

channels.name: Wyoming child abuse and neglect reporting
channels.what_it_can_do: Starts a Department of Family Services child protection response. Reports go to the county field office where the abuse or neglect happened or is happening.
channels.who_to_report: A child at a Wyoming program. Report to the county the program sits in.
channels.how: Call the county field office, or 911 at any hour to reach local law enforcement. The state line will also direct you.
channels.phone_note: Also 307-777-7564. For an emergency at any hour, 911.

channels.name: Wyoming DFS child care and facility licensing
channels.what_it_can_do: Licenses Wyoming's child care and residential facilities and takes concerns that one has breached its licensing requirements.
channels.how: Contact the child care licenser for the area, or the licensing support contact.

channels.name: Wyoming DFS Ombudsman
channels.what_it_can_do: Takes complaints about how the Department of Family Services has handled a case.
channels.what_it_cannot_do: It reviews the Department rather than the program.
channels.who_to_report: A family or young person whose report to DFS has gone nowhere.

channels.name: Wyoming Protection and Advocacy System
channels.what_it_can_do: Wyoming's federally mandated P&A, with authority to investigate abuse and neglect of people with disabilities in facilities, a right of access to them, and free legal advocacy.
channels.who_to_report: A Wyoming program where the young person has a disability or a mental health diagnosis.
